name: Henry Hungwa
title: Full-Stack Developer
tagline: I design and build products end to end — mobile apps, web platforms, and developer tools.
bio: I'm a full-stack developer who likes shipping real products. I've taken apps from idea to the App Store and Play Store, built two-sided platforms, and released open-source developer tools — turning complex problems into simple, well-made software.
bioExtended: I work across the stack: mobile, web, backend, and the AI and automation layers in between. When I'm not building my own products, I'm exploring new tech and contributing to open source.
